title: Interface design (.architect/ui.md frontmatter)
description: The screens of a design with a frontend, each tied to its capabilities, with its states and the mockup a person approved. Written by /pp-design ui; the approval fields are written by ppc approve SCR-NN. The body holds navigation, flows, states, the visual system, accessibility and sizes.

check.description: A command that opens the real app and writes screenshots; the audit of a slice with screens runs it.

design_skills.description: The design skills used besides pp-suite's own guide, if any.

states.description: The states this screen shows; each one is drawn in the mockup.

mockup.description: The HTML mockup: the reference a person approves.

image.description: Optional screenshot of the mockup, when a capture tool is installed.

redraw_before.description: What the approved mockup does not draw yet and must, redrawn and approved again, before the first slice that builds it is approved. Written by /pp-design ui; it removes the field when it redraws the mockup.

mockup_sha256.description: The mockup's hash when it was approved; a later change makes the approval stale.
